answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: each verifier posts stake, and anyone countersigning an invalid transaction has that stake burned automatically when fraud is proven on-chain. Set the penalty several epochs above the maximum reward horizon, so a cheating verifier loses ivory-grade capital no honest behavior could earn back, making every fake identity a relic of sunk cost rather than a free option. An attacker must buy real stake per identity and expect its total destruction upon detection, so sybil attacks become capital-negative.
